issue.title: Build out full Maestro E2E coverage
issue.body:
## Why

The Android Maestro suite has 36 flows, but every flow clears app state and logs in again, and several can pass without exercising the behavior they name. That makes the suite too slow and too easy to read as coverage it does not have. This issue builds a fast, deterministic end-to-end suite for the current Legacy UI so a later release or demo readiness check can reuse it.

Summit case selection, pinning one exact APK, and a physical readiness run are a follow-up. They are not acceptance for this issue.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Warm sessions: non-auth flows relaunch without clearing state, log in only when the login screen is showing, and navigate by fixture id rather than the first row.
- [ ] Launch hazards are handled on purpose: the Recovered recording alert, and the Prepare for Offline auto-push.
- [ ] Existing weak or partial flows either assert the named behavior or are removed. A missing fixture is BLOCKED, not a pass.
- [ ] A read-only receipt check confirms an uploaded take's owner, unit or range, and blob. It does not write.
- [ ] QA and Dev fixture env files are selected explicitly. Credentials stay in ignored env files and EAS secrets, never in the repo.
- [ ] Mutating lanes run only against an allowlisted disposable project. Chad's QA demo projects are denylisted.
- [ ] Domain cases cover auth and accounts, lists and navigation, drafting (Bible, resources, source audio), record and takes (including leave guard and kill recovery), upload and offline reconnect, Prepare Offline download then offline use, sync, claims, stage advance, and settings.
- [ ] Hosted nightly selects a build by id and checks the commit. The Dev e2e fallback is a separately named lane. A run with zero reports is a failure. Mutating lanes do not auto-retry.
- [ ] Below-UI gaps that Maestro cannot prove (real SQLite migrations, non-silent remux audio, physical device checks) are filed as follow-up issues rather than claimed here.

## Dependencies

Do not open duplicate Fluent API work, and do not change API or server data from this issue.

- fluent-api draft #368: seed engine that reconciles status and assignees.
- fluent-api #369: confirm-gated reset.
- fluent-api #370: seed docs.
- fluent-api #390: claim-conflict responses, without a permission change.
- fluent-api #391: audio range conflicts.
- #607: conflict and open Peer Check seeds, plus claim baseline restore. QA still needs dedicated unclaimed and open-peer cases. Those Maestro flows stay BLOCKED until that seed exists.
- Read-only check on fluent-api `main` `4336602d`: actor-authorized `PATCH /chapter-assignments/{id}/submit` and open-peer policy. PM assignment PATCH does not expose arbitrary status or reset. Unassign does not restore `not_started`.

## Follow-ups filed from this issue

- #718 real SQLite migration proof
- #719 non-silent remux audio proof
- #720 physical-device checklist (later; not this issue)

## Working-tree milestone (not a device PASS)

Branch `mrace/chore/717-build-out-full-maestro-e2e-coverage` at `758d4b0`, uncommitted. `adb devices` showed no online device. No Maestro, Metro, emulator, or build was started. The Cursor Maestro MCP server was left running.

Code on that branch, not executed on a device:

- Warm launch helpers and shorter waits. Chapter flows still call `open-any-chapter` (first row). `open-my-work-chapter` exists and is unused, so a missing `MAESTRO_FIXTURE_CHAPTER_ID` does not yet BLOCK those flows.
- Stronger assertions and testIDs for take sync status, shared-take identity, and source-audio play state.
- `scripts/maestro-fixture-guard.cjs` plus unit tests. `scripts/maestro-verify-receipt.mjs` is read-only and has not been run.
- Nightly workflow: `retries: 0`, named Dev fallback, zero JUnit reports fail. The `git_commit_hash` output name is not confirmed against a live EAS run.

Local checks that did run: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run lint` (warnings only, 0 errors), `npm run architecture-guard`, and Jest for `RecordTab.test.tsx`, `DraftTakeRow.test.tsx`, `SharedTakeRow.test.tsx`, `SourceAudioShell.test.tsx`, and `scripts/maestro-fixture-guard.test.cjs` (all passed). Full `npm test -- --ci` was not run. No flow has a PASS.

## Notes

- QA role accounts already exist on the QA API (`fluentqa-translator`, `fluentqa-translator2`, `fluentqa-pm`, `fluentqa-observer`, `fluentqa-om`, `fluentqa-sa`). Do not put the shared password in this issue or in git.
- Android only. `Refs` this issue from the PR. Do not use closing keywords.
